Always an honor to be on with @AlanEyre1. We discussed Israel's role in the Iran war. In my estimation, a significant decline in American support for Israel is inevitable. Unlike the Iraq war, where Israel's role was debatable, in the Iran war, Israel's role was central.

Video

Iran's demands for Israel to also end attacks on Lebanon and Gaza are not solely because of Tehran's desire to show solidarity with the peoples there, but also because it recognizes that if Israel continues to bombard Gaza and Lebanon, that conflict risks expanding to Iran again - as it already has twice since October 7.

To ensure a durable end to Israel's war with Iran, Israel's war on Gaza and Lebanon must also end.

Video

Told @aje that the military option with Iran was tested - and it failed. Going forward, the potency of American military threats in US-Iran diplomacy no longer carries much weight. This will fundamentally change the dynamic in US-Iran talks.

Video

Told @mehdirhasan that Trump has given the theocracy in Iran another lease on life with this failed war, just as Saddam Hussein did in 1980 when he invaded Iran and, by that, ensured that Ayatollah Khomeini could consolidate his power.
